Credit Memo — Project Beacon

$18M senior bridge loan. 142-unit garden multifamily, Charlotte NC.

Deal Snapshot
$18.0M Loan
65% LTV
1.38x DSCR
36mo Term

Executive Summary

Project Beacon is a value-add bridge refinance on a 1998-vintage 142-unit garden multifamily in the Steele Creek submarket of Charlotte. The sponsor has executed on 64% of the original renovation plan over the trailing 22 months and seeks bridge debt to retire the existing CMBS loan and fund the remaining capex.

In-place trailing-three-month NOI annualizes to $1,485k against the proposed $18.0M senior loan, producing a 1.38x DSCR at the underwritten 6.75% all-in coupon.
